items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The name 'Don' appears only in the interviewer's question: 'Don, did you have some lunch?' There is no mention of Don by the interviewee or any description of a relationship between the interviewee and Don.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Don, did you have some lunch? No, I'm all right. Would you like something? Anything you, would you like a drink? Or- Get some stuff from downstairs. Do you want anything? No, not right now. All right. Thanks. What's that, what? That's the recorder. What happened? If that's the recorder, they come with noise. You see me making noise noise? Well, sure. The machine's gone, broke down. That's what's happened. It broke? The machine broke? No. No. Cutting contest. That's what I call a cutting contest. No,…

Mm-hmm. That's a pretty good band. Mm-hmm. There they are in the band, they hired me back that Friday. Uh-huh. That's a pretty good band. There they are in the band, they hired me back that Friday. Uh-huh. And they had a very good band. They had Billy Butler, a guy called Bonner, myself, Mutt, Bud Scott, and Fred Walsh on
